steps.say: A long vowel sound can be spelt in more than one way.
Ai often goes in the middle of a word. Ay often goes at the end.
Long e can be ee or ea. You need to learn which one.
Long i can be igh or ie. Long o can be oa or ow.
Oo can be long, like moon, or short, like book.
If you are not sure, write the word both ways and see which looks right.

hints: All four try to spell the same word.
The sound is at the end of the word.
At the end, long a is often ay.
check.explanation: Day is spelt d, ay. Ay often spells long a at the end of a word.

options.why: Ai does not usually go at the end of a word.
This is not how we spell it.

hints: The middle sound is a long o.

check.explanation: Boat is spelt b, oa, t.
